title: ⬇️ Trump Advisers Worry He Could ‘Sink to the High 20s’
author: Asawin Suebsaeng
content:
_On this day in 2018, former Trump lawyer and fixer Michael Cohen pleaded
guilty to charges arising from making payments to women who claimed affairs
with his boss. Cohen served prison time and emerged as a stringent critic of
Trump but has now crawled back onside,[ interviewing the president on his
radio show](https://x.com/KitMaherCNN/status/2090566299311116645?s=46)
Thursday night._

Happy Friday! It's **Swin** , again. I have seen a lot of you making the same
complaint, and it goes something like this: **Donald Trump** is such a
horrendous U.S. president on so many different personal and policy fronts; I
know his poll numbers are garbage right now, but how is it even possible that
he's consistently clinging to more than 30% favorability in the polling? What
does a doddering fascist have to do to crack the 20s?

_Well_ … in today's '**First Draft** ,' I may have a surprise for you: You're
not the only ones wondering that. Some very well-connected consultants and
Trump whisperers are thinking about the scary 20s, too - and they're not
pleased about it. Plus, Trump's DOJ opens yet another absurd but frightening
front in his war on his enemies, and the Iran stalemate keeps on stalemating
hard. Let's read in.

# How Low Can He Go?

Did you see the news this week? (No, [not that](https://zeteo.com/p/inside-
trumplands-freakout-over-natalie).)

**" Trump approval falls to 33%, lowest of his presidency, Reuters/Ipsos poll
finds,"** Reuters [reported](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-approval-
falls-33-lowest-his-presidency-reutersipsos-poll-finds-2026-08-17/) on Monday.
**" Trump's approval rating plummets to new low ahead of critical midterms,"**
[announced](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-approval-rating-plummets-
new-low-ahead-critical-midterms.amp) Fox News, the president's [source of
comfort and advice](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-advisers-trash-fox-for-nearly).

American Research Group (which doesn't have the reputation other pollsters do)
clocked him [at an even
](https://bsky.app/profile/polltracker.bsky.social/post/3mtjeyvnhts2j)_[30](https://bsky.app/profile/polltracker.bsky.social/post/3mtjeyvnhts2j)_.

**" Nearly a quarter of Americans who voted for President Trump in 2024
believe they are worse off financially since he returned to office last year,
according to a new survey,"**
[said](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/6032764-donald-trump-
second-term-republicans-survey/amp/) the _Financial Times_.

**" Republican support for Trump has fallen as Democrats hold a big lead among
enthusiastic midterms voters,"** [said](https://yougov.com/en-
us/articles/55391-republican-support-donald--trump-fallen-democrats-hold-big-
lead-among-enthusiastic-midterms-voters-august-14-17-2026-economist-yougov-
poll) the _Economist_ and YouGov, noting that **" about one-third (35%) of
Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Donald Trump's job performance as
president."**

Private polls commissioned by different organizations and arms of the
Republican elite **" aren't much better,"** I'm told by an operative close to
the White House who has knowledge of data causing a
[sustained](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-pollsters-2026-midterms)
[bedwetting](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-is-making-republicans-wet-their) from
much of the party that President Trump is going to drag them down hard in the
[critically important](https://zeteo.com/p/inside-dems-plans-to-fight-back-
trump-ice-polls) midterms.

Of course, one leading cause of these through-the-floor numbers is Trump's
catastrophic war on Iran. The data, and common sense, tell you that.
